## confirmation

<!-- tick the box by putting an x between the brackets: [x] -->

- [ ] this is my own discord user id and i'm requesting deletion of my own data

## what happens

gronka will remove the data tied to this user id: your stored profile row, usage
metrics, the media you've downloaded/converted/optimized (both the database records
and the underlying files), and any alerts referencing you. content-addressed files
that another user also produced are left in place.

moderation records (e.g. an active ban) are **not** removed by a deletion request.
